spiritual_reading:
#
 The Seven
 Works of the Living Spirit:
 Spiritual
 Translation


---


**
¶1:**
 Divine
 Truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine
 Good has
 accomplished
 a
 complete work
 of regeneration through
 seven successive
 operations
 of its
 power
.

**¶2:** The
 first
:
 It
 raised
 up
 the celest
ial will —
 the in
most good of innoc
ence that
 had
 descended into the conflict
 of tem
ptation —
 as
 a precious interior
 good is
 drawn up from the overwhelming depths
 of sensory falsity
 and natural obsc
urity.

**¶3:**
 The second: It spread out
 and
 exposed
 the self
-love that had risen in
 rebellion
 against divine order, and fixed
 it in a
 state
 of restra
int within every external form of the natural
 man,
 so that it could
 no
 longer act
 freely
 from
 itself
.

**¶4:** The
 third: It subj
ugated,
 heaped into containment, and
 penetrated the very
 root
-
evils and root
-falsities that produce spiritual death —
 rendering
 them powerless in
 their
 essential
 nature.

**¶5:**
 The
 fourth: It formed
 doc
trinal vessels of
 wisdom
 —
 containing
 structures
 of understanding
 through
 which divine light could be
 carried across
 the states of regeneration.

**
¶6:** The fifth: It
 called
 forth the
 five interior spiritual faculties and
 arranged
 them in their proper order throughout
 the sphere of heav
enly life.
 These
 faculties took
 possession of the ordered
 spiritual region
 and
 sustained
 the
 entire weight
 of all
 derivative states
 of existence.
 Furthermore
, it called forth three essential
 divine truths proce
eding from the Lord
's t
rine nature
 — celest
ial, spiritual, and natural — and
 set
 each
 upon
 its corresponding containing
 form at
 the
 three
 discrete
 degrees,
 and
 another
 upon the external
 natural
 man
 in
 its fullness.
 And
 again it
 sent
 forth the divine
 calling, that
 it might be con
joined with the five illumin
ated interior faculties,
 viv
ifying them with infl
ux
 from
 above
.

**¶7:** The
 sixth: When
 the
 ordered
 spiritual
 sphere
 had been constructed
, Divine
 Truth arose
 and sent
 forth a multitude of specific
 operations of good
 and truth — active
 powers
 and minist
ering
 intellig
ences —
 so that they would establish
 the protective
 boundaries of
 the heav
enly order on
 every side,
 until all
 the works of
 regeneration were completed. And when
 all had
 been finished
, it gathered
 some
 of these
 powers
 into the
 interior
 repositories of good
 and truth —
 the
 deep
 st
orehouses of spiritual
 memory — and stationed
 others at posts
 of vigilance along
 the boundaries between
 the spiritual
 and
 the
 natural,
 as
 perpet
ual guard
ians of order
.

**¶8:** The
 seventh: At the time when the Divine
 Human revealed
 its glor
ified
 form in
 its fullness, Divine
 Truth established many distinct
 goods
 and truths in their
 proper arrangement
 throughout
 heaven
.
 They
 took
 hold of the
 entire
 edific
e of the
 regenerated mind so
 that the whole
 spiritual
 structure would
 not
 collapse
,
 and so
 that no
 part
 would
 turn
 against the divine
 wisdom
 that
 had been impl
anted throughout
.


*
The
 image
 of "
the Ambassador
 displaying his glorious image" res
ists
 simple
 correspondence
;
 it reads
 most
 truly
 as the Lord's full
 glorification —
 the moment
 when the Divine Human is
 made
 fully
 visible
 as
 the ruling
 form
 of all
 heav
enly order
,
 and all
 subordin
ate goods
 and truths are permanently
 established by
 that
 manifest
ation.*

**
¶9:** And
 there
 remains
 one
 further
 great
 and glorious work that Divine
 Truth will accomplish
 at the cons
ummation:
 it is
 the ultimate
 and
 final form
 of the regenerated human —
 the complete image and
 lik
eness of the Divine Human —
 which it will raise
 up into
 the eternal states of heavenly wisdom.
 And it takes
 hold of all
 that
 remains
,
 and strikes
 down
 what
 is last
 of
 opposition
, and builds the
 final
 order
,
 and g
athers all things
 into unity
.


---

*
Note on
 "
the Last Statue": This image
 —
 a
 statue
 raised
 to
 the aeons of light — corresponds
 most
 closely
 to what
 Swedenborg calls
 the
*
 im
ago Dei *fully
 realized
:
 the completed
 regener
ate
 person
 as
 a
 form
 recept
ive of the
 Lord
's life
,
 elevated
 at
 last
 into heaven
.
 The word
 "statue
" suggests
 a
 fixed
 and
 final
 form, the
 spiritual
 body
 in
 its permanent
 state.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Living Spirit has done seven [wo]rks with his strength.
[The fi]rst: He brought the First Man up from the contest, the way a pearl is [brought] up from the sea.
The third: He [tr]ampled, piled up, and pierced the essences of death.
[The f]ourth: He constructed the ships of light.

The fi[f]th: He evoked his five sons, and distributed them about. They [took] possession of the zone, they bore up under all the universe's weight. Also, he evoked three living words. He set [them] upon the th[re]e vessels, another one upon the giant. [Again, he evoked the] summons, that it might be mixed with the five shining men.

The sixth: When he had constructed the zone he aro[se] and s[e]nt forth a multitude of powers and many [angel]s; so that they would bound the circuit of the z[o]ne on every si[de], un[t]il he finished [co]nstructing the works. And at the end [of] all the [wor]ks he to[ok s]ome of them into his storehouses, and he appointed others at the watch-posts.

Also another gr[ea]t and glorious work he will enact at the e[nd] is [the] Last [Statue], which he will bring up to the aeons of [light]; and he [enters] in, and [he ta]kes hold, and he smites [the remnant of darkness], and [he] builds, and he [purifies], and he [gathers t]hem.
[The second: He spread about the one who had rebelled, he crucified [h]im in every body.
